nativeScope: Owned Win32 disposable editor, parameterized replace and append macros; no general native claim
nativeAdjustment: Native execution is a separate smaller smoke suite under acceptance section 12E. Browser acceptance retains 100 paired episodes per method per seed.
splitRule: Whole sessions with disjoint parameter strings. Final sessions generated only after candidate selection. Policy reads only BEFORE images, user request context and earlier delivered actions.
benefitCriterion: Better success than initialized, or fewer observations with success noninferiority margin 0.02. Fixed selector and original context ablation reported separately.
promotion: zero false success; all seeds and exact counts; all reload errors zero; all ONNX errors <0.0001; lower bootstrap95 success delta >0 OR upper bootstrap95 observation delta <0 with lower success delta >=-0.02; scoped qualification only
selection: Use the final epoch only if every validation seed accuracy >=0.95 and parity/reload gates pass. Do not retune from final outcomes. Preserve failed campaigns under separate versions.
nonClaims: Native learner superiority over competent fixed selector
